about: The PULSE-1 assembly film (MOTION.md, S2). One frame map read by blender/pulse_film.py and the page's frame loader. Frames are 0-based. It opens on every part scattered in a cloud; each group then assembles into its own layer in signal-path order (panel, board, keys, case: each key frame is where that layer has landed and its fact shows); the four layers then close into the finished instrument.
